newsitem.title: POLAND: IB AUSTRIA RATES KABLE AS "HOLD".
newsitem.headline: IB AUSTRIA RATES KABLE AS "HOLD".

text.p: Investmentbank Austria recommended in its March 20 report to hold shares of Poland's Slaska Fabryka Kabli SA (SFK) saying the firm was in a position to improve its earnings this year after a poor 1996.

"After a difficult year in 1996, the company is in a position to greatly improve its financial results. Longer term prospects for the company depend on NKT. We recommend holding SFK's shares," the report said.
Earlier on Monday Denmark's NKT Cables announced a public tender offer to buy one million shares in Kable at 41 zlotys per share.
Last month NKT raised its Kable stake to 50 percent, or one million shares, by buying 500,000 shares from Denmark's Investment Fund for Central and Eastern Europe.
IB Austria said Kable's net profit should double to 5.4 million zlotys this year and rise to 6.1 million in 1998 from an estimated 2.9 million million in 1996.
It predicted the company's sales would increase to 162.5 million zlotys this year and 185 million in 1998 from an estimated 141.3 million in 1996.
